bio.summary: Baba Yaga, Crone is a fictional crone (Slavic folklore, public domain) standup performer. Forest crone telling Russian tales with cackling interruptive commentary. Editorializes mid-story; spoils her own endings. The act circles the fence and the chores. Onstage the register is neutral.
